pari dhatta dhatta no varcasemaṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇuta dīrgham āyuḥ । bṛhaspatiḥ prāyachad vāsa etat somāya rājñe paridhātavā u ॥4॥
jarāṃ su gacha pari dhatsva vāso bhavā gṛṣṭīnām abhiśastipā u । śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcī rāyaś ca poṣam upasaṃvyayasva ॥5॥
parīdaṃ vāso adhithāḥ svastaye 'bhūr vāpīnām abhiśastipā u । śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīr vasūni cārur vi bhajāsi jīvan ॥6॥
yogeyoge tavastaraṃ vājevāje havāmahe । sakhāya indram ūtaye ॥7॥
hiraṇyavarṇo ajaraḥ suvīro jarāmṛtyuḥ prajayā saṃ viśasva । tad agnir āha tad u soma āha bṛhaspatiḥ savitā tad indraḥ ॥8॥
aśrāntasya tvā manasā yunajmi prathamasya ca । utkūlam udvaho bhavoduhya prati dhāvatāt ॥1॥
agneḥ prajātaṃ pari yad dhiraṇyam amṛtaṃ dadhre adhi martyeṣu । ya enad veda sa id enam arhati jarāmṛtyur bhavati yo bibharti ॥1॥
yad dhiraṇyaṃ sūryeṇa suvarṇam prajāvanto manavaḥ pūrva īṣire । tat tvā candraṃ varcasā saṃ sṛjaty āyuṣmān bhavati yo bibharti ॥2॥
āyuṣe tvā varcase tvaujase ca balāya ca । yathā hiraṇyatejasā vibhāsāsi janām̐ anu ॥3॥
yad veda rājā varuṇo veda devo bṛhaspatiḥ । indro yad vṛtrahā veda tat ta āyuṣyaṃ bhuvat tat te varcasyaṃ bhuvat ॥4॥
gobhiṣ ṭvā pātv ṛṣabho vṛṣā tvā pātu vājibhiḥ । vāyuṣ ṭvā brahmaṇā pātv indras tvā pātv indriyaiḥ ॥1॥
somas tvā pātv oṣadhībhir nakṣatraiḥ pātu sūryaḥ । mādbhyas tvā candro vṛtrahā vātaḥ prāṇena rakṣatu ॥2॥
tisro divas tisraḥ pṛthivīs trīṇy antarikṣāṇi caturaḥ samudrān । trivṛtaṃ stomaṃ trivṛta āpa āhus tās tvā rakṣantu trivṛtā trivṛdbhiḥ ॥3॥
trīn nākāṃs trīn samudrāṃs trīn bradhnāṃs trīn vaiṣṭapān । trīn mātariśvanas trīnt sūryān goptṝn kalpayāmi te ॥4॥
ghṛtena tvā sam ukṣāmy agne ājyena vardhayan । agneś candrasya sūryasya mā prāṇaṃ māyino dabhan ॥5॥
mā vaḥ prāṇaṃ mā vo 'pānaṃ mā haro māyino dabhan । bhrājanto viśvavedaso devā daivyena dhāvata ॥6॥
prāṇenāgniṃ saṃ sṛjati vātaḥ prāṇena saṃhitaḥ । prāṇena viśvatomukhaṃ sūryaṃ devā ajanayan ॥7॥
āyuṣāyuḥkṛtāṃ jīvāyuṣmān jīva mā mṛthāḥ । prāṇenātmanvatām jīva mā mṛtyor ud agā vaśam ॥8॥
devānāṃ nihitaṃ nidhiṃ yam indro 'nvavindat pathibhir devayānaiḥ । āpo hiraṇyaṃ jugupus trivṛdbhis tās tvā rakṣantu trivṛtā trivṛdbhiḥ ॥9॥
trayastriṃśad devatās trīṇi ca vīryāṇi priyāyamāṇā jugupur apsv antaḥ । asmiṃś candre adhi yad dhiraṇyaṃ tenāyaṃ kṛṇavad vīryāṇi ॥10॥
ye devā divy ekādaśa stha te devāso havir idaṃ juṣadhvam ॥11॥
ye devā antarikṣa ekādaśa stha te devāso havir idaṃ juṣadhvam ॥12॥
ye devā pṛthivyām ekādaśa stha te devāso havir idaṃ juṣadhvam ॥13॥
asapatnaṃ purastāt paścān no abhayaṃ kṛtam । savitā mā dakṣiṇata uttarān mā śacīpatiḥ ॥14॥
divo mādityā rakṣantu bhūmyā rakṣantv agnayaḥ । indrāgnī rakṣatāṃ mā purastād aśvināv abhitaḥ śarma yachatām । tiraścīn aghnyā rakṣatu jātavedā bhūtakṛto me sarvataḥ santu varma ॥15॥
imaṃ badhnāmi te maṇiṃ dīrghāyutvāya tejase । darbhaṃ sapatnadambhanaṃ dviṣatas tapanaṃ hṛdaḥ ॥1॥
dviṣatas tāpayan hṛdaḥ śatrūṇāṃ tāpayan manaḥ । durhārdaḥ sarvāṃs tvaṃ darbha gharma ivābhīnt saṃtāpayan ॥2॥
gharma ivābhitapan darbha dviṣato nitapan maṇe । hṛdaḥ sapatnānāṃ bhinddhīndra iva virujaṃ balam ॥3॥
bhinddhi darbha sapatnānāṃ hṛdayaṃ dviṣatāṃ maṇe । udyan tvacam iva bhūmyāḥ śira eṣāṃ vi pātaya ॥4॥
bhinddhi darbha sapatnān me bhinddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ । bhinddhi me sarvān durhārdo bhinddhi me dviṣato maṇe ॥5॥
chinddhi darbha sapatnān me chinddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ । chinddhi me sarvān durhārdo chinddhi me dviṣato maṇe ॥6॥
vṛśca darbha sapatnān me vṛśca me pṛtanāyataḥ । vṛśca me sarvān durhārdo vṛśca me dviṣato maṇe ॥7॥
kṛnta darbha sapatnān me kṛnta me pṛtanāyataḥ । kṛnta me sarvān durhārdo kṛnta me dviṣato maṇe ॥8॥
piṃśa darbha sapatnān me piṃśa me pṛtanāyataḥ । piṃśa me sarvān durhārdo piṃśa me dviṣato maṇe ॥9॥
vidhya darbha sapatnān me vidhya me pṛtanāyataḥ । vidhya me sarvān durhārdo vidhya me dviṣato maṇe ॥10॥
nikṣa darbha sapatnān me nikṣa me pṛtanāyataḥ । nikṣa me sarvān durhārdo nikṣa me dviṣato maṇe ॥1॥
tṛnddhi darbha sapatnān me tṛnddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ । tṛnddhi me sarvān durhārdo tṛnddhi me dviṣato maṇe ॥2॥
runddhi darbha sapatnān me runddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ । runddhi me sarvān durhārdo runddhi me dviṣato maṇe ॥3॥
mṛṇa darbha sapatnān me mṛṇa me pṛtanāyataḥ । mṛṇa me sarvān durhārdo mṛṇa me dviṣato maṇe ॥4॥
mantha darbha sapatnān me mantha me pṛtanāyataḥ । mantha me sarvān durhārdo mantha me dviṣato maṇe ॥5॥
piṇḍḍhi darbha sapatnān me piṇḍḍhi me pṛtanāyataḥ । piṇḍḍhi me sarvān durhārdo piṇḍḍhi me dviṣato maṇe ॥6॥
oṣa darbha sapatnān me oṣa me pṛtanāyataḥ । oṣa me sarvān durhārdo oṣa me dviṣato maṇe ॥7॥
daha darbha sapatnān me daha me pṛtanāyataḥ । daha me sarvān durhārdo daha me dviṣato maṇe ॥8॥
jahi darbha sapatnān me jahi me pṛtanāyataḥ । jahi me sarvān durhārdo jahi me dviṣato maṇe ॥9॥
yat te darbha jarāmṛtyu śataṃ varmasu varma te । tenemaṃ varmiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapatnāṃ jahi vīryaiḥ ॥1॥
śataṃ te darbha varmāṇi sahasraṃ vīryāṇi te । tam asmai viśve tvāṃ devā jarase bhartavā aduḥ ॥2॥
tvām āhur devavarma tvāṃ darbha brahmaṇas patim । tvām indrasyāhur varma tvaṃ rāṣṭrāṇi rakṣasi ॥3॥
sapatnakṣayaṇaṃ darbha dviṣatas tapanaṃ hṛdaḥ । maṇiṃ kṣatrasya vardhanaṃ tanūpānaṃ kṛṇomi te ॥4॥
yat samudro abhyakrandat parjanyo vidyutā saha । tato hiranyayo bindus tato darbho ajāyata ॥5॥
audumbareṇa maṇinā puṣṭikāmāya vedhasā । paśūṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sphātiṃ goṣṭhe me savitā karat ॥1॥
yo no agnir gārhapatyaḥ paśūnām adhipā asat । audumbaro vṛṣā maṇiḥ saṃ mā sṛjatu puṣṭyā ॥2॥
karīṣiṇīṃ phalavatīṃ svadhām irāṃ ca no gṛhe । audumbarasya tejasā dhātā puṣṭiṃ dadhātu me ॥3॥
yad dvipāc ca catuṣpāc ca yāny annāni ye rasāḥ । gṛhṇe 'haṃ tv eṣāṃ bhūmānaṃ bibhrad audumbaraṃ maṇim ॥4॥
puṣṭiṃ paśūnām pari jagrabhāhaṃ catuṣpadāṃ dvipadāṃ yac ca dhānyam । payaḥ paśūnāṃ rasam oṣadhīnāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ savitā me ni yachāt ॥5॥
ahaṃ paśūnām adhipā asāni mayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatir dadhātu । mahyam audumbaro maṇir draviṇāni ni yachatu ॥6॥
upa maudumbaro maṇiḥ prajayā ca dhanena ca । indreṇa jinvito maṇir ā māgant saha varcasā ॥7॥
devo maṇiḥ sapatnahā dhanasā dhanasātaye । paśor annasya bhūmānaṃ gavāṃ sphātiṃ ni yachatu ॥8॥
yathāgre tvaṃ vanaspate puṣṭhyā saha jajñiṣe । evā dhanasya me sphātim ā dadhātu sarasvatī ॥9॥
ā me dhanaṃ sarasvatī payasphātiṃ ca dhānyam । sinīvāly upā vahād ayaṃ caudumbaro maṇiḥ ॥10॥
tvaṃ maṇīṇām adhipā vṛṣāsi tvayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatir jajāna । tvayīme vājā draviṇāni sarvaudumbaraḥ sa tvam asmat sahasvārād ārād arātim amatiṃ kṣudhaṃ ca ॥11॥
grāmaṇīr asi grāmaṇīr utthāya abhiṣikto 'bhi mā siñca varcasā । tejo 'si tejo mayi dhārayādhi rayir asi rayiṃ me dhehi ॥12॥
puṣṭir asi puṣṭyā mā sam aṅgdhi gṛhamedhī gṛhapatiṃ mā kṛṇu । audumbaraḥ sa tvam asmāsu dhehi rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ ni yacha rāyas poṣāya prati muñce ahaṃ tvām ॥13॥
ayam audumbaro maṇir vīro vīrāya badhyate । sa naḥ saniṃ madhumatīṃ kṛṇotu rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīram ni yachāt ॥14॥
śatakāṇḍo duścyavanaḥ sahasraparṇa uttiraḥ । darbho ya ugra oṣadhis taṃ te badhnāmy āyuṣe ॥1॥
nāsya keśān pra vapanti norasi tāḍam ā ghnate । yasmā achinnaparṇena darbhena śarma yachati ॥2॥
divi te tūlam oṣadhe pṛthivyām asi niṣṭhitaḥ । tvayā sahasrakāṇḍenāyuḥ pra vardhayāmahe ॥3॥
tisro divo aty atṛṇat tisra imāḥ pṛthivīr uta । tvayāhaṃ durhārdo jihvāṃ ni tṛṇadmi vacāṃsi ॥4॥
tvam asi sahamāno 'ham asmi sahasvān । ubhau sahasvantau bhūtvā sapatnān sahiṣīvahi ॥5॥
sahasva no abhimātiṃ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ । sahasva sarvān durhārdaḥ suhārdo me bahūn kṛdhi ॥6॥
darbheṇa devajātena divi ṣṭambhena śaśvad it । tenāhaṃ śaśvato janām̐ asanaṃ sanavāni ca ॥7॥
priyaṃ mā darbha kṛṇu brahmarājanyābhyām śūdrāya cāryāya ca । yasmai ca kāmayāmahe sarvasmai ca vipaśyate ॥8॥
yo jāyamānaḥ pṛthivīm adṛṃhad yo astabhnād antarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca । yaṃ bibhrataṃ nanu pāpmā viveda sa no 'yaṃ darbho varuṇo divā kaḥ ॥9॥
sapatnahā śatakāṇḍaḥ sahasvān oṣadhīnāṃ prathamaḥ saṃ babhūva । sa no 'yaṃ darbhaḥ pari pātu viśvatas tena sākṣīya pṛtanāḥ pṛtanyataḥ ॥10॥
sahasrārghaḥ śatakāṇḍaḥ payasvān apām agnir vīrudhāṃ rājasūyam । sa no 'yaṃ darbhaḥ pari pātu viśvato devo maṇir āyuṣā saṃ sṛjāti naḥ ॥1॥
ghṛtād ullupto madhumān payasvān bhūmidṛṃho 'cyutaś cyāvayiṣṇuḥ । nudant sapatnān adharāṃś ca kṛṇvan darbhā roha mahatām indriyeṇa ॥2॥
tvaṃ bhūmim aty eṣy ojasā tvaṃ vedyāṃ sīdasi cārur adhvare । tvāṃ pavitram ṛṣayo 'bharanta tvaṃ punīhi duritāny asmat ॥3॥
tīkṣṇo rājā viṣāsahī rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇiḥ । ojo devānāṃ balam ugram etat taṃ te badhnāmi jarase svastaye ॥4॥
darbheṇa tvaṃ kṛṇavad vīryāṇi darbhaṃ bibhrad ātmanā mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ । atiṣṭhāya varcasādhānyānt sūrya ivā bhāhi pradiśaś catasraḥ ॥5॥
jāṅgiḍo 'si jaṅgiḍo rakṣitāsi jaṅgidaḥ । dvipāc catuṣpād asmākaṃ sarvaṃ rakṣatu jaṅgidaḥ ॥1॥
yā gṛtsyas tripañcāśīḥ śataṃ kṛtyākṛtaś ca ye । sarvān vinaktu tejaso 'rasāṃ jaṅgidas karat ॥2॥
arasaṃ kṛtrimaṃ nādam arasāḥ sapta visrasaḥ । apeto jaṅgiḍāmatim iṣum asteva śātaya ॥3॥
kṛtyādūṣaṇa evāyam atho arātidūṣaṇaḥ । atho sahasvāñ jaṅgiḍaḥ pra na āyumṣi tāriṣat ॥4॥
sa jaṅgiḍasya mahimā pari ṇaḥ pātu viśvataḥ । viṣkandhaṃ yena sāsaha saṃskandham oja ojasā ॥5॥
triṣ ṭvā devā ajanayan niṣṭhitaṃ bhūmyām adhi । tam u tvāṅgirā iti brāhmaṇāḥ pūrvyā viduḥ ॥6॥
na tvā pūrvā oṣadhayo na tvā taranti yā navāḥ । vibādha ugro jaṅgiḍaḥ paripāṇaḥ sumaṅgalaḥ ॥7॥
athopadāna bhagavo jāṅgiḍāmitavīrya । purā ta ugrā grasata upendro vīryaṃ dadau ॥8॥
ugra it te vanaspata indra ojmānam ā dadhau । amīvāḥ sarvāś cātayaṃ jahi rakṣāṃsy oṣadhe ॥9॥
āśarīkaṃ viśarīkaṃ balāsaṃ pṛṣṭyāmayam । takmānaṃ viśvaśāradam arasāṃ jaṅgiḍas karat ॥10॥

dcs_text: indrasya nāma gṛhṇanta ṛṣayo jaṅgiḍaṃ daduḥ / devā yaṃ cakrur bheṣajam agre viṣkandhadūṣaṇam
samudra_ru: Зхватывая имя Индры, Риши отдали джангиду, Которую боги создали вначале Как лекарство, портящее вишкандху.

dcs_text: sa no rakṣatu jaṅgiḍo dhanapālo dhaneva / devā yaṃ cakrur brāhmaṇāḥ paripāṇam arātiham
samudra_ru: Пусть эта джангида защищает нас, Как хранитель богатств — богатства, (Та), которую создали боги (и) брахманы Как (нашего) хранителя повсюду, убийцу скупых!

dcs_text: durhārdaḥ saṃghoraṃ cakṣuḥ pāpakṛtvānam āgamam / tāṃs tvaṃ sahasracakṣo pratībodhena nāśaya paripāṇo 'si jaṅgiḍaḥ
samudra_ru: Злосердечного, очень грозного вида явившегося творца зла — Заставь ты их исчезнуть, о тысячеглазая, С помощью (твоей) бдительности! Ты джангида, защищающая повсюду.

dcs_text: pari mā divaḥ pari mā pṛthivyāḥ pary antarikṣāt pari mā vīrudbhyaḥ / pari mā bhūtāt pari mota bhavyād diśo diśo jaṅgiḍaḥ pātv asmān
samudra_ru: С неба меня, с земли меня, Из воздушного пространства, из растений меня, Из того, что было, меня, а также из того, что будет, меня — Из каждой стороны света джангида пусть нас защитит!

dcs_text: ya ṛṣṇavo devakṛtā ya uto vavṛte 'nyaḥ / sarvāṃstān viśvabheṣajo 'rasāṁ jaṅgiḍas karat
samudra_ru: Какие колдуны (?) созданы богами, А также какие происходят от людей (?) — Всех их всеисцеляющая джангида Пусть сделает лишенными сока! с амулетом шатавара>
śatavāro anīnaśad yakṣmān rakṣāṃsi tejasā । ārohan varcasā saha maṇir durṇāmacātanaḥ ॥1॥
śṛṅgābhyāṃ rakṣo nudate mūlena yātudhānyaḥ । madhyena yakṣmaṃ bādhate nainaṃ pāpmāti tatrati ॥2॥
ye yakṣmāso arbhakā mahānto ye ca śabdinaḥ । sarvāṃ durṇāmahā maṇiḥ śatavāro anīnaśat ॥3॥
śataṃ vīrān ajanayac chataṃ yakṣmān apāvapat । durṇāmnaḥ sarvān hatvāva rakṣāṃsi dhūnute ॥4॥
hiraṇyaśṛṅga ṛṣabhaḥ śātavāro ayaṃ maṇiḥ । durṇāmnaḥ sarvāṃs tṛdhvāva rakṣāṃsy akramīt ॥5॥
śatam ahaṃ durṇāmnīnāṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ śatam । śatam śaśvanvatīnāṃ śatavāreṇa vāraye ॥6॥
idaṃ varco agninā dattam āgan bhargo yaśaḥ saha ojo vayo balam । trayastriṃśad yāni ca vīryāṇi tāny agniḥ pra dadātu me ॥1॥
varca ā dhehi me tanvāṃ saha ojo vayo balam । indriyāya tvā karmaṇe vīryāya prati gṛhṇāmi śataśāradāya ॥2॥
ūrje tvā balāya tvaujase sahase tvā । abhibhūyāya tvā rāṣṭrabhṛtyāya pary ūhāmi śataśāradāya ॥3॥
ṛtubhyaṣ ṭvārtavebhyo mādbhyaḥ saṃvatsarebhyaḥ । dhātre vidhātre samṛdhe bhūtasya pataye yaje ॥4॥
na taṃ yakṣmā arundhate nainaṃ śapatho aśnute । yaṃ bheṣajasya gulguloḥ surabhir gandho aśnute ॥1॥
viṣvañcas tasmād yakṣmā mṛgā aśvā iverate । yad gulgulu saindhavaṃ yad vāpy asi samudriyam ॥2॥
ubhayor agrabhaṃ nāmāsmā ariṣṭatātaye ॥3॥
aitu devas trāyamāṇaḥ kuṣṭho himavatas pari । takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśaya sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ॥1॥
trīṇi te kuṣṭha nāmāni nadyamāro nadyāriṣaḥ । nadyāyaṃ puruṣo riṣat । yasmai paribravīmi tvā sāyaṃprātar atho divā ॥2॥
jīvalā nāma te mātā jīvanto nāma te pitā । nadyāyaṃ puruṣo riṣat । yasmai paribravīmi tvā sāyaṃprātar atho divā ॥3॥
uttamo asy oṣadhīnām anaḍvān jagatām iva vyāghraḥ śvapadām iva । nadyāyaṃ puruṣo riṣat । yasmai paribravīmi tvā sāyaṃprātar atho divā ॥4॥
triḥ śāmbubhyo aṅgirebhyas trir ādityebhyas pari । trir jāto viśvadevebhyaḥ । sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati ।
aśvattho devasadanas tṛtīyasyām ito divi । tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuṣṭho ajāyata । sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati ।
hiraṇyayī naur acarad dhiraṇyabandhanā divi । tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuṣṭho ajāyata । sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati ।
yatra nāvaprabhraṃśanaṃ yatra himavataḥ śiraḥ । tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuṣṭho ajāyata । sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati ।
yaṃ tvā veda pūrva ikṣvāko yaṃ vā tvā kuṣṭha kāmyaḥ । yaṃ vā vaso yam ātsyas tenāsi viśvabheṣajaḥ ॥9॥
śīrṣaśokaṃ tṛtīyakaṃ sadaṃdir yaś ca hāyanaḥ । takmānaṃ viśvadhāvīryādharāñcaṃ parā suva ॥10॥
yan me chidraṃ manaso yac ca vācaḥ sarasvatī manyumantaṃ jagāma । viśvais tad devaiḥ saha saṃvidānaḥ saṃ dadhātu bṛhaspatiḥ ॥1॥
mā na āpo medhāṃ mā brahma pra mathiṣṭana । suṣyadā yūyaṃ syandadhvam upahūto 'haṃ sumedhā varcasvī ॥2॥
mā no medhāṃ mā no dīkṣāṃ mā no hiṃsiṣṭaṃ yat tapaḥ । śivā naḥ śaṃ santv āyuṣe śivā bhavantu mātaraḥ ॥3॥
yā naḥ pīparad aśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamas tiraḥ । tām asme rāsatām iṣam ॥4॥
bhadram ichanta ṛṣayaḥ svarvidas tapo dīkṣām upaniṣedur agre । tato rāṣṭraṃ balam ojaś ca jātaṃ tad asmai devā upasaṃnamantu ॥1॥
brahma hotā brahma yajñā brahmaṇā svaravo mitāḥ । adhvaryur brahmaṇo jāto brahmaṇo 'ntarhitaṃ haviḥ ॥1॥
brahma sruco ghṛtavatīr brahmaṇā vedir uddhitā । brahma yajñasya tattvaṃ ca ṛtvijo ye haviṣkṛtaḥ । śamitāya svāhā ॥2॥
aṃhomuce pra bhare manīṣām ā sutrāvṇe sumatim āvṛṇānaḥ । imam indra prati havyaṃ gṛbhāya satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ॥3॥
aṃhomucaṃ vrṣabhaṃ yajñiyānāṃ virājantaṃ prathamam adhvarāṇam । apāṃ napātam aśvinā huve dhiya indriyeṇa ta indriyaṃ dattam ojaḥ ॥4॥
